claims.statement: Jem Mace said he beat Tom Allen easily in a fight in New Orleans in 1870.
claims.excerpt: fight Tom Allen in New Orleans in 1870.

quotes.speaker: Jem Mace
quotes.text:
I would train and Win Just as easily as I did when ou saw me
fight Tom Allen in New Orleans in 1870.

fights.excerpt: fight Tom Allen in New Orleans in 1870.
fights.notes: Mace's own claim in a letter that he won easily; the result is not confirmed by this article.

notes: Mace's letter, reprinted in the Post-Dispatch. Allen's role is only as the opponent Mace recalls.
